note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Prepare statements run in one PowerShell session with the episode folder as current directory; variables do not survive into the screens, so each screen re-derives what it needs.
prepare: # owner signed in off camera: gh auth login (scopes repo, delete_repo). Never run gh auth status on camera.
if (gh repo view "$owner/guardrails-demo" --json name 2>$null) { gh repo delete "$owner/guardrails-demo" --yes }

Get-ChildItem 'C:\work\guardrails-demo\.githooks' -Recurse -File -Force -Include *.cs,*.csproj,*.props,*.slnx,*.slnf,*.json,*.md,*.yml,*.yaml,*.py,*.sh,*.toml,*.config,*.http,*.runsettings,*.playlist,*.ts,Dockerfile,compose.yaml,CODEOWNERS,.gitignore,.gitattributes,.editorconfig,pre-commit,commit-msg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(node_modules|bin|obj|\.git)\\' } | ForEach-Object { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName) -replace "`r`n", "`n")) }; Get-ChildItem 'C:\work\guardrails-demo\scripts' -Recurse -File -Force -Include *.cs,*.csproj,*.props,*.slnx,*.slnf,*.json,*.md,*.yml,*.yaml,*.py,*.sh,*.toml,*.config,*.http,*.runsettings,*.playlist,*.ts,Dockerfile,compose.yaml,CODEOWNERS,.gitignore,.gitattributes,.editorconfig,pre-commit,commit-msg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(node_modules|bin|obj|\.git)\\' } | ForEach-Object { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName) -replace "`r`n", "`n")) }; Get-ChildItem 'C:\work\guardrails-demo\tools' -Recurse -File -Force -Include *.cs,*.csproj,*.props,*.slnx,*.slnf,*.json,*.md,*.yml,*.yaml,*.py,*.sh,*.toml,*.config,*.http,*.runsettings,*.playlist,*.ts,Dockerfile,compose.yaml,CODEOWNERS,.gitignore,.gitattributes,.editorconfig,pre-commit,commit-msg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(node_modules|bin|obj|\.git)\\' } | ForEach-Object { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName) -replace "`r`n", "`n")) }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force tests | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$PWD\tests\test_smoke.py", "def test_smoke():`n    assert True`n")
git config user.name 'Alex Demo'; git config user.email 'alex.demo@contoso.com'
git add .; git commit -m 'chore: add repo guardrails'; git push -u origin main
# first PR so the three check names exist, then lock main
git switch -c chore/first-ci; git commit --allow-empty -m 'ci: first run'; git push
gh pr create --fill; gh pr checks --watch

screens.name: badcommit
prepare: git switch main 2>$null; git branch -D feature/orders-paging 2>$null; git reset -q --hard
commands: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force src | Out-Null; 'PAGE_SIZE = 50' | Set-Content src/orders.py; git add src/orders.py
screens.note: Runs in PowerShell 7 with Git Bash on PATH, so `bash` is Git Bash and the hooks find python3 through the shim from prepare.

screens.name: secret
prepare: git switch feature/orders-paging 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git switch -c feature/orders-paging }
commands: New-Item x -ItemType File | Out-Null; git add x
screens.note: The token is random and fake (ghp_ plus 36 characters); it never leaves the machine because the pre-commit hook blocks it. Blur it in the edit anyway.

screens.name: ruleset
screens.account: the lab GitHub account (repo admin, signed in by the owner)
steps: Open the repository guardrails-demo, then Settings, then Rules, then Rulesets
Show Enforcement status: Active, and Target branches: Default
Scroll to Restrict deletions and Block force pushes (both ticked)
Scroll to Require a pull request: 1 approval, code owners, dismiss stale approvals, most recent push approval, conversation resolution, allowed merge method Squash only
Scroll to Require status checks to pass: test, secret-scan, pr-title, with the strict (up to date) option
If it does not fit on one screen, take two captures and keep the one with the pull request and status checks sections
mask: repository owner in the URL bar, breadcrumbs and avatar menu
owner name in the code owners line

screens.name: pr
screens.account: the lab GitHub account (signed in by the owner)
prepare: if (-not (gh pr list --head feature/orders-paging --json number --jq '.[].number')) { gh pr create --title 'updated orders' --body 'Paging for orders' }
steps: Open the pull request 'updated orders' (feature/orders-paging into main) on the Conversation tab
Scroll to the bottom: pr-title failed (red), test and secret-scan passed, 'Review required', merge button disabled, only 'Squash and merge' offered
Click the title Edit button and rename it to: feat(orders): add paging
Open the Checks tab, re-run the failed pr-title job (Re-run failed jobs), go back to Conversation
Show pr-title green and only the review still missing
mask: repository owner in the URL bar, breadcrumbs and avatar menu
reviewer / author name if it is not the public lab account

teardown: # gh needs the delete_repo scope: the owner ran gh auth refresh -s delete_repo
$owner = gh api user --jq .login; gh repo delete "$owner/guardrails-demo" --yes
